metaDescription: Deck Revitalize won Burlington's 2026 Deck & Fence Staining award. See its deep-prep process, colour-matching and 70+ years team experience.
summary: Deck Revitalize is an outdoor wood restoration specialist serving Burlington, Hamilton, Oakville and Mississauga, with more than 70 years of combined team experience. The company covers deck staining, sanding and resurfacing along with fence, pergola and gazebo treatments.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Deck Revitalize offers a wide menu of outdoor wood services, including deck staining, power washing, sanding, resurfacing, fence staining and painting, and pergola and gazebo treatments, covering most exterior wood surfaces on a typical property rather than decks alone. More than 70 years of combined team experience sits behind the work, a figure built from the tenure of multiple crew members rather than the age of the company itself. That range means one company can be booked for a deck, fence and pergola project together.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: The company's process centres on deep surface preparation, properly cleaning, sanding and drying wood before any stain or paint is applied, which it positions as the step that determines whether a finish adheres correctly and lasts. Colour-matching expertise is highlighted specifically, useful for homeowners trying to match a new fence section to existing stained wood or coordinate a deck and pergola finish. This preparation-first approach is presented as the difference between a finish that lasts and one that peels early.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One reviewer said the company transformed their dilapidated deck into the highlight of their home, praising unmatched attention to detail and professionalism. Another said their 15-year-old deck looks brand new, describing the crew as punctual and clean with a gorgeous final finish.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Deck Revitalize serves Burlington, Hamilton, Oakville and Mississauga. Homeowners outside this footprint should confirm coverage before booking.

strengths: Covers decks, fences, pergolas and gazebos under one contractor rather than decks alone.
Process centres on deep cleaning, sanding and drying before any product is applied.
More than 70 years of combined team experience in outdoor wood restoration.
Specific colour-matching expertise for coordinating new and existing stained surfaces.
considerations: Full deep-prep restoration takes longer than a quick recoat over already-sound wood.
A wide service menu is a strength for multi-structure projects but confirm crew availability for larger jobs.
Exterior staining is seasonal work, so booking is tightest through spring and fall.
bestFor: Older, weathered decks needing full sanding and resurfacing
Homeowners wanting a deck, fence and pergola finished to match
Anyone specifically needing colour-matching on an addition or repair section
Gazebo or pergola staining alongside a deck project
questionsToAsk: What does the deep surface preparation involve for my specific deck condition?
Can you colour-match a new fence section to my existing stained deck?
How long does the wood need to dry between washing and staining?
What finish or stain product do you recommend for a gazebo versus a ground-level deck?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Deck Revitalize was selected as the top business in the Deck & Fence Staining category for Burlington through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: Do they do more than decks?
faq.a: Yes. Fence staining and painting, and pergola and gazebo staining, are listed alongside deck services, so the company covers most exterior wood structures on a property.

faq.q: Why does surface preparation matter so much?
faq.a: The company positions cleaning, sanding and proper drying before staining as the step that determines whether a finish adheres correctly and lasts, rather than peeling within a season.
Deck Revitalize serves Burlington, Hamilton, Oakville and Mississauga, according to its listed service area.
